text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become strong!
I'll train and train, become stronger and faster than anyone else, and prove that I won't lose to anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm counting on you!
Trainer, let's do it together...
Bulk uuup!!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
